name: @alcyo/desktop
description: Turn a long stream into captioned vertical shorts, on your own computer.
author: Hardik Vora

scripts.package:mac: electron-vite build && node ../../scripts/fetch-binaries.ts --verify --target mac-arm64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
